updates.name: Mindy Roberts
updates.bio: Executive Director of the Puget Sound Partnership, Washington's state agency for Puget Sound recovery, appointed in March 2026. She previously directed Washington Conservation Action's Puget Sound program for ten years and worked 16 years at Washington's Department of Ecology as an environmental engineer, where she led Salish Sea water-quality modeling.
updates.evidence: EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR'S OFFICE Mindy Roberts Executive Director
updates.notes: Governor's release of March 5, 2026 (200) announces her appointment as PSP executive director and gives prior roles; PSP staff page (200) lists her as Executive Director. Existing homepage psp.wa.gov/staff.php is a staff list, not a personal page; no individual PSP page found, so homepage not changed. No ORCID or research-interests page found.

updates.name: Mark S. Seyfried
updates.bio: Soil scientist with the USDA Agricultural Research Service and investigator at the Reynolds Creek Critical Zone Observatory, holding a University of Florida PhD in soil physics. Research examines how soils vary across semiarid mountain landscapes and how that shapes water movement and plant growth, along with soil water and temperature instruments and process models that bridge scales.
updates.research_interests: spatial variation of soils; soil water and temperature measurement; soil water modeling; soil physics; hydrology
updates.evidence: Mark S. Seyfried ... INVESTIGATOR ... Reynolds ... Soil Scientist, USDA-Agricultural Research Service
updates.notes: Bio source is the archived Reynolds Creek CZO profile (200; the CZO program ended, page is an archive, latest listed paper 2020), so it is not set as homepage. The Reynolds CZO people page (czo-archive.criticalzone.org/reynolds/people/) lists him as a contact and investigator. Existing ORCID checked at pub.orcid.org: name Mark Seyfried, employment USDA-ARS 1988-present (consistent; unchanged). No fetched page states emeritus/retired, so status not written. ARS NWRC people list renders no names server-side; ARS person page not found. Verifier 2026-10-26: current_affiliation trimmed to what the cited profile states ('Soil Scientist, USDA-Agricultural Research Service'); it does not name the Northwest Watershed Research Center.

updates.name: Rosemary G. Gillespie
updates.bio: Professor in UC Berkeley's Department of Environmental Science, Policy and Management (Organisms and Environment division). Research centers on evolutionary ecology, systematics and spider biology, using Pacific hotspot archipelagoes such as Hawaii, the Marquesas and the Society Islands, whose islands differ in age, to trace how species diversify and communities assemble over time.
updates.research_interests: evolutionary ecology; systematics; spiders; conservation; diversification and community assembly on Pacific hotspot islands
updates.current_affiliation: Department of Environmental Science, Policy & Management, University of California, Berkeley
